doc.title: Tony Parenti and Anthony Sbarbaro Interview, 1959-06-29

title: Mic test and introductions of the two Tonys at Elmhurst
summary: Sound check, then the interviewer states the date (June 29, 1959) and place, and the two Tonys joke about introductions.

story.theme_name: Starting the tape: names, dates and places

blocks.x: Alan, why can't I remember that? That's so simple.
Yeah, just think of red, Alan, you remember it. Yeah. Okay.
I just got a car from him. I want red. In the Orleans. Yeah. I'm on the Orleans right now. Huh? Right down there. Went down there for three weeks vacation. Yeah? Yeah. Let's see.

I think this is going to record alright now. Okay. I think we got it. This is tape being recorded at the home of Tony Perini, 8306 Titor Avenue, Elmhurst, Long Island. And it's Monday, June the 29th, 1959. So. Tony, let's either Tony give you a name or both of you.

Well, that's a very interesting point of view. We have two Tonys here. Of course, my Tony is parted on the side and the other Tony is parted also on the side. I think we both got a lot in common also with our hairdo. So let's discuss this thing without going into commercial hairdos. What's your name now?
Tell us all the second. All right.
